privileged_info_for_vlm: The target event is the 2024 Noto Peninsula earthquake (Japan). To display this historical event, both 'events.visibleTimeSpan' and 'events.retention' must be set to at least 1000d (or 86400000 seconds) in ~/.seiscomp/scmv.cfg. The final screenshot must be saved to /home/ga/scmv_noto_map.png and must show the earthquake symbol over the Noto Peninsula region of Japan.
